title: Clouds Series
meta: Output: Diasec Print, Fine Art Print (Hahnemühle Photo Rag / German Etching), Custom Archival
statement: This series explores clouds as direct representations of human emotion. Each formation embodies a different state of being — color becomes mood, form becomes feeling. The clouds in this work are not metaphors. They are the emotions: bold pinks pulse with love or chaos, golden hues carry joy or longing, and deep shadows speak to pressure or silence. These skies reflect the inner world we often keep hidden — messy, radiant, and always shifting. By making emotion visible in atmospheric form, Clouds Series — 2023 invites the viewer to recognize their own weather, and to embrace it.
